operation.description: provision makes a guest; configure sets up one that exists, from a guest's setup.recipe or a pipeline stage; stage is an OpenTofu root a pipeline applies.

root.description: The OpenTofu root module or Ansible project, relative to this file.

inputs.description: JSON Schema validating the guest's hardware and network, for a configure recipe its setup.inputs, or for a pipeline stage its inputs, relative to this file.

secrets.description: The extra vars a guest must provide in setup.secrets or setup.secretFiles.

actions.description: What can be run from this project, by name.

prepare.description: A playbook run on the agent before approval, with no secrets and no access to the guest. What it writes to OCTOPUSHY_PREPARED_FILE becomes extra vars. Relative to root.

snapshot.description: applied reuses what the guest's last successful run prepared.

destructive.description: Whether this action can delete data or a service. Octopushy cannot tell from a playbook, so this is required, and true waits under policy.destructive: manual.

onChange.description: Run this action when the guest's setup or the recipe's files change. At most one action says so.

outcomes.description: Results a playbook may report with set_stats, other than success or failure.

approve.description: A person may approve running the action once more with these extra vars.

result.description: How the run ends without an approval.

image.description: Overrides the server's default image for the executor. Ignored by an agent with the local tool runtime.
